meta.source: Extracted from the pandoc Word styles of the padnir reports (rewrites/*.docx): Times New Roman and Calibri text, black ink, accent #4F81BD, table header fill #D9E2F3, 11pt body at 1.15 line, 15pt bold title, 13pt bold headings, 9.5-10pt table text. Re-expressed for a zooming presentation canvas.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The infinite canvas behind every frame. Page background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Fill of a content frame sitting on canvas.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Source table-header fill. Table heads, soft frames, quiet buttons on hover. Ink text is legible on it in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table rules, frame outlines on canvas. Never text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on canvas, surface and mist (above 12:1 in both themes). Softened from the source's pure black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, eyebrows, table notes on canvas and surface (above 7:1).

tokens.name: canvas-blue
tokens.usage: Primary. The current path step, primary buttons, the opening overview frame, links. Also usable as text on canvas and surface (6:1 light, 6.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a canvas-blue fill.

tokens.name: report-blue
tokens.usage: The source documents' accent, kept for continuity with the printed reports. Fills and text 24px or larger only: 4.0:1 on white fails for body text (kept as found, flagged).

tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: Warm topic hue and highlights. Fill only; text on it is ink-fixed.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Second topic hue: evidence, findings. Fill, or text on surface in light theme (5.2:1).

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text on a teal fill.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Third topic hue and the one alert colour. Fill only; text on it is ink-fixed.

tokens.name: ink-fixed
tokens.usage: Dark text that stays dark in both themes: on saffron and coral fills (above 5:1).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips, between eyebrow and title.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, gap in button rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Small frame padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Frame padding, gap between topic circles.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large frame padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between frames on the canvas.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Canvas margin around an overview.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Table, inputs, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, path bar.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Content frames on the canvas.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Topic circles: the overview's zoom targets.

tokens.name: shadow-frame
tokens.usage: A frame lifted off the canvas. One level only.
